messages:
maria gonzalez: Quick handoff — oncall saw a weird oscillation in dedicated-west-3 earlier. pool scaled down then back up within ~3m. CPU/QPS looked steady. Anyone know the best per-pool signals to correlate with autoscale flaps? pinging @aj and @devon :eyes:
oncall-bot: Incident 5821 created for pool=dedicated-west-3 (low). link: https://incidents.redwood.company/5821
aj patel: Good call. I’d check kvcache eviction rate + steal/steal_queue metrics. Specifically: `kvcache.evictions_total` (rate), `scheduler.steal_queue_length`, and `pool.autoscale_events`. We have a Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/pool-insights/dedicated-pools — set var.pool=dedicated-west-3

developer hint (grafana query example):
```
sum by (pool) (rate(kvcache_evictions_total[5m]))
sum by (pool) (rate(scheduler_steal_queue_length[5m]))
```

devon li: Also look at `kv_cache_hit_ratio` and `kvcache.memory_pressure` around the times. Evictions + falling hit ratio often precede short-lived scale-ups because requests miss the cache and add CPU/kernel overhead.

leo chan: If you want a quick cross-correlation, I can throw together a small panel combining evictions vs autoscale events. Would that help?
maria gonzalez: Yes please, Leo — that would be super helpful. Can you also add a 1h vs 5m rollup comparison? The pattern looked like a tight spike then recovery.

leo chan: On it. I’ll add a panel and link it here when done. ETA 30–45m.
aj patel: For alerting: we should avoid firing on single short spikes. Consider `for: 10m` for the autoscale-triggering alert or use a ratio of evictions/hit-rate instead of raw evictions. Example rule pseudo: `eviction_rate / kvcache_items_total > 0.001 for 10m`
maria gonzalez: Good suggestion. Can you open a PR to update the alert rule? Tagging @devon for review when you do.
aj patel: Will do after Leo lands the panel.
oncall-bot: Deploy bot: grafana/dashboard/pool-insights updated by leo chan (PR #887).

leo chan: Panel added: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/pool-insights/dedicated-pools?view=evictions_correlation&var-pool=dedicated-west-3 — I included 1m, 5m, and 1h rollups and an overlay of autoscale events.
maria gonzalez: Nice — that link is perfect. I can see the spike aligning with several evictions. I'll wait for AJ's PR for the alert change and then we can roll to staging. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

devon li: Quick note for the playbook: add a checklist item "check kvcache.hit_ratio vs evictions" under dedicated pool flapping. Saves time for future handoffs.
maria gonzalez: Agreed. I'll add that to the runbook after this.

aj patel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/912 — adds eviction-based dampening and `for: 10m`. @devon can you review?
devon li: Reviewing now.
maria gonzalez: Thanks team. If it happens again within the next day, I'll re-open the incident and include these graphs. Otherwise I'll close 5821 after we verify staging.
